payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all possible split points by evaluating zeros before and ones after each index, taking the maximum sum.
payload.rationale: The code exhaustively tries all ways to choose a prefix of zeros and suffix of ones via nested loops, a brute-force search over the split point. It does not use recursion or backtracking, but among the provided complete_search subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest generic match.
